title: 6. Special Planet Facts (VERY HIGH EXAM VALUE)

blocks.content: • Mercury – Smallest planet and fastest revolution.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Mercury is the smallest planet and has the fastest revolution speed.
Venus is the hottest planet owing to the greenhouse effect and rotates in the opposite direction to most planets.
Earth remains the only known planet with liquid water.
Jupiter is the largest planet, featuring the iconic Great Red Spot storm.
Saturn is the least dense planet and is unique for being able to float in water.
Neptune possesses the strongest winds among all planets.
